verdict.rationale: Luma documents agent-readable material: a live llms.txt, markdown versions of doc pages, a generation endpoint with Python/JS/TS SDKs, and a per-model credit price table (e.g., 20 credits for 5s 360p Draft). Together these let an agent submit a prompt and estimate cost from docs alone. Nothing in the evidence shows how to poll or watch a job, retrieve the generated asset, or read the actual cost per job through the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented job-status/polling flow, documented asset download/retrieval, per-job cost or usage reporting via API, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.
